card.title: Authority on Paper
card.instruction: Project firm control through titles and procedure, then tighten the formalities whenever anyone tests whether your position has real support.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: As emergency neighbourhood chair, I'm assigning you to unblock the communal drain.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There are only two of us here. I never agreed you were chair.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then you must formally nominate an alternative before withholding cooperation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: First, an eligibility hearing. As the challenged incumbent, I'll chair it; you'll need someone else to second your nomination.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 uses the chair title to assign drain work, A3 requires an alternative nomination after dissent, and A5 adds an eligibility hearing with a seconder after B complies.

responseLogic.evidence: B2's no-agreement challenge causes A3's nomination rule; B4's self-nomination causes A5's new hearing and seconding barrier.

relationship.evidence: B2 challenges an unwanted work assignment and B4 uses the offered procedure to contest A's role.

heightening.evidence: A5 uses B4's valid nomination to tighten the process while appointing A to judge it.

specificity.evidence: A1 establishes a blocked communal drain and B2 the two-person gathering.
